obs: "Prior to the taking effect of that act, the courts of Illinois held that at common law all partners were liable without limitation for the debts of the firm, and that, in order to limit such liability, the statute authorizing limited partnerships must be complied with, or all those who associated under it would be liable as general partners."
"This statute applied only to acts of contempt committed in the presence of the court and left all other cases of contempt to be ascertained and punished according to the course of the common law."
